summary: A foreign public service that shows the local authority's warnings, in English, above its own hours.

callouts.title: Warnings with a status word
callouts.does_well: Five banners for Lisboa: "Ongoing: Yellow Coastal Event Warning", "Expected: Orange Rain Warning", "Expected: Red Rain Warning", "Expected: Red Wind Warning", "Expected: Orange Coastal Event Warning". Each opens for the text.
callouts.fed_by: incidents/2026-11-10-storm-charles/data/weather/warnings.json (status from start_utc and end_utc against now)

callouts.title: The calm table
callouts.does_well: Time, symbol, temperature, precipitation in mm, wind in m/s with an arrow. No decoration.

callouts.title: Wind in words
callouts.does_well: "Fresh breeze from south east": a reader who does not think in metres per second still understands. But the words describe the automatic mean wind under a red wind warning, and the page does not say so.
callouts.fed_by: the warning's own text beside any model wording

callouts.title: Previous day, next day
callouts.does_well: Two buttons; the table is one day at a time.
